notes.title: News Regarding 2023's April Fools Game: The Hole of Love
notes.content:
Hello everyone! This year I have published a new April Fools game within Object Ward's universe: [b]The Hole of Love[/b]. 
[i]Play as Acevedo and stop the consummation between Manson and Miss Pencil Sharpener by any means necessary![/i]
Contains 5 endings, 6 CGs, and the longest April Fools' game of the bunch!
Unfortunately, I have both bad and good news about its addition to the April Fools Collection.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42223496/ac0626f64d5a8efbed6297a11893f6d9aae04dec.png[/img]
First, the bad. The Hole of Love uses a slightly different GUI that is incompatible with the two previous April Fools Games. Because of this, I am unable to include THOL in the collection. Until a resolution has been found, both collections on itch and steam will be on hiatus.

Good news: A fantastic dev friend of mine, [url=https://www.bobcgames.com/]Bobcgames[/url], is working on a workaround! It may be a launcher, able to play any type of Renpy game, regardless of GUI. We will return with an update as soon as we can, so please be patient!

In the meantime, you can play THOL for free on itch.io [url=https://thugzilla.itch.io/the-hole-of-love]HERE[/url]! In due time, it will be incorporated into the April Fools Collection, forever 1$. Any purchases, whether a tip on itch or buying the collection here, is appreciated. All funds go towards developing Object Ward, and I couldn't do it without you.
